 }

 /* &#9472;&#9472; mostrar &#9472;&#9472;&#9472;&#9472;&#9472;&#9472;&#9472;&#9472;&#9472;&#9472;&#9472;&#9472;&#9472;&#9472;&#9472;&#9472;&#9472;&#9472;&#9472;&#9472;&#9472;&#9472;&#9472;&#9472;&#9472;&#9472;&#9472;&#9472;&#9472;&#9472;&#9472;&#9472;&#9472;&#9472;&#9472; */
 function mostrar(rect, texto) {
 clearTimeout(hideTimer);
 stored = texto;

 iconEl.className = 'fas fa-copy';
 labelEl.textContent = 'Copiar';
 countEl.textContent = texto.length + ' car.';
 tip.classList.remove('widg_copy_success');
 tip.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Copiar seleção de ' + texto.length + ' caracteres');

 posicionar(rect);
 tip.classList.add('widg_copy_visible');
 }

 /* &#9472;&#9472; sucesso &#9472;&#9472;&#9472;&#9472;&#9472;&#9472;&#9472;&#9472;&#9472;&#9472;&#9472;&#9472;&#9472;&#9472;&#9472;&#9472;&#9472;&#9472;&#9472;&#9472;&#9472;&#9472;&#9472;&#9472;&#9472;&#9472;&#9472;&#9472;&#9472;&#9472;&#9472;&#9472;&#9472;&#9472;&#9472; */
 function sucesso() {
 iconEl.className = 'fas fa-check';
 labelEl.textContent = 'Copiado!';
 tip.classList.add('widg_copy_success');
 tip.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Texto copiado');
 hideTimer = setTimeout(esconder, 1400);
 console.log('[widg_copy] Copiado: ' + stored.length + ' caracteres');
 }

 /* &#9472;&#9472; esconder &#9472;&#9472;&#9472;&#9472;&#9472;&#9472;&#9472;&#9472;&#9472;&#9472;&#9472;&#9472;&#9472;&#9472;&#9472;&#9472;&#9472;&#9472;&#9472;&#9472;&#9472;&#9472;&#9472;&#9472;&#9472;&#9472;&#9472;&#9472;&#9472;&#9472;&#9472;&#9472;&#9472;&#9472;&#9472; */
 function esconder() {
 tip.classList.remove('widg_copy_visible', 'widg_copy_success');
 }

 /* &#9472;&#9472; fallback execCommand &#9472;&#9472;&#9472;&#9472;&#9472;&#9472;&#9472;&#9472;&#9472;&#9472;&#9472;&#9472;&#9472;&#9472;&#9472;&#9472;&#9472;&#9472;&#9472;&#9472;&#9472;&#9472;&#9472; */
 function fallback() {
 try {
 var ta = document.createElement('textarea');
 ta.value = stored;
 ta.style.cssText = 'position:fixed;top:-9999px;left:-9999px;opacity:0;pointer-events:none';
 document.body.appendChild(ta);
 ta.focus();
 ta.select();
 document.execCommand('copy');
 document.body.removeChild(ta);
 sucesso();
 } catch (e) {
 console.error('[widg_copy] Fallback falhou:', e);
 /* showToast não disponível no widget &#8212; log silencioso */
 }
 }

 /* &#9472;&#9472; copiar &#9472;&#9472;&#9472;&#9472;&#9472;&#9472;&#9472;&#9472;&#9472;&#9472;&#9472;&#9472;&#9472;&#9472;&#9472;&#9472;&#9472;&#9472;&#9472;&#9472;&#9472;&#9472;&#9472;&#9472;&#9472;&#9472;&#9472;&#9472;&#9472;&#9472;&#9472;&#9472;&#9472;&#9472;&#9472;&#9472; */
 function copiar() {
 if (!stored) return;
 if (navigator.clipboard && navigator.clipboard.writeText) {
 navigator.clipboard.writeText(stored).then(sucesso).catch(fallback);
 } else {
 fallback();
 }
 }

 /* &#9472;&#9472; detectar seleção &#9472;&#9472;&#9472;&#9472;&#9472;&#9472;&#9472;&#9472;&#9472;&#9472;&#9472;&#9472;&#9472;&#9472;&#9472;&#9472;&#9472;&#9472;&#9472;&#9472;&#9472;&#9472;&#9472;&#9472;&#9472;&#9472; */
 function detectar() {
 var sel = window.getSelection ? window.getSelection() : null;
 var text = sel ? sel.toString().trim() : '';

 if (!text || text.length 

 Recursos 404 detectados 
 &times; 

// console.log('&#9989; Widget 404: Webhook enviado com sucesso'))
 .catch(err => console.error('&#10060; Widget 404: Erro ao enviar webhook:', err));
 }

 function adicionarItemRecurso(tipo, url) {
 if (EXCEPTION_URLS.some(exception => url.includes(exception))) {
 console.log(`Widget 404: Ignorando URL: ${url}`);
 return;
 }

 if (url.includes("blogger.googleusercontent.com") && url.includes("s16000-rw")) {
 console.log(`Widget 404: Ignorando imagem Blogger: ${url}`);
 return;
 }

 const li = document.createElement('li');
 li.style.marginBottom = '6px';
 li.style.wordBreak = 'break-all';
 li.innerHTML = ` ${tipo}: ${url} 
 Copiar `;

 const btnCopy = li.querySelector('button');
 btnCopy.addEventListener('click', () => {
 navigator.clipboard.writeText(url).then(() => {
 btnCopy.textContent = '&#9989; Copiado';
 setTimeout(() => {
 btnCopy.textContent = 'Copiar';
 }, 1500);
 }).catch(err => {
 console.error('Widget 404: Erro ao copiar:', err);
 });
 });

 const is404 = getUrlParam('404') === 'true';
 if (is404) {
 STATE.list.appendChild(li);
 STATE.panel.style.display = 'block';
 }

 STATE.resources.push(`${tipo}: ${url}`);
 sendToWebhook(STATE.resources.join(', '));
 }

 function inicializarWidget() {
 const is404 = getUrlParam('404') === 'true';

 if (!is404) {
 STATE.panel.style.display = 'none';
 }

 STATE.closeBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
 STATE.panel.style.display = 'none';
 });

 window.addEventListener('error', function(e) {
 const target = e.target;
 if (target.tagName === 'IMG' || target.tagName === 'SCRIPT' || target.tagName === 'LINK') {
 const url = target.src || target.href;
 const tipo = target.tagName;
 if (url && !STATE.brokenResources.has(url)) {
 STATE.brokenResources.add(url);
 adicionarItemRecurso(tipo, url);
 }
 }
 }, true);

 console.log('&#9989; Widget 404: Detector inicializado');
 }

 if (testParam) {

 link: window.location.href.split('?')[0],
 problemas: 'teste de envio'
 };

 body: JSON.stringify(payload),
 mode: 'no-cors'
 })
 .then(() => console.log('&#9989; Widget 404: Teste enviado com sucesso'))
 .catch(err => console.error('&#10060; Widget 404: Erro no teste:', err));
 }
 }

 inicializarWidget();
 executarTesteModo();

 /* &#9472;&#9472; Atualizar consentimento para GRANTED &#9472;&#9472; */
 function grantConsent() {
 window.gtag('consent', 'update', {
 ad_storage: 'granted',
 ad_user_data: 'granted',
 ad_personalization: 'granted',
 analytics_storage: 'granted'
 });
 }

 /* &#9472;&#9472; Atualizar consentimento para DENIED (sinal explícito) &#9472;&#9472; */
 function denyConsent() {
 window.gtag('consent', 'update', {
 ad_storage: 'denied',
 ad_user_data: 'denied',
 ad_personalization: 'denied',
 analytics_storage: 'denied'
 });
 }

 /* &#9472;&#9472; Fluxo de consentimento LGPD &#9472;&#9472; */
 function handleConsent() {
 /* GA4 config e GTM sempre carregam &#8212; o Consent Mode v2 já garante
 que nada é armazenado/enviado com dados pessoais até o granted */
 configGA4();
 initGTM();
 attachEvents();

 var saved = getCookie(COOKIE_KEY);

 if (saved === 'granted') {
 grantConsent();
 return;
 }

 if (saved === 'denied') {
 denyConsent(); /* reforça o sinal a cada visita */
 return;
 }

 /* Sem preferência salva &#8212; exibe banner */
 var banner = document.getElementById('cqb-consent-banner');
 if (banner) banner.style.display = 'flex';

 var btnAccept = document.getElementById('cqb-accept');
 var btnDecline = document.getElementById('cqb-decline');

 if (btnAccept) {
 btnAccept.addEventListener('click', function () {
 setCookie(COOKIE_KEY, 'granted', COOKIE_TTL);
 if (banner) banner.style.display = 'none';
 grantConsent();
 });
 }

 if (btnDecline) {
 btnDecline.addEventListener('click', function () {
 setCookie(COOKIE_KEY, 'denied', COOKIE_TTL);
 if (banner) banner.style.display = 'none';
 denyConsent();
 });
 }
 }

 /* &#9472;&#9472; Disparo &#9472;&#9472; */
 if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
 document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', handleConsent);
 } else {
 handleConsent();
 }

})();

 imagensSemAlt.forEach(function (img, index) {

 // 1. ADICIONA ALT TEXT DESCRITIVO
 const altAtual = img.getAttribute("alt");

 if (titleImg && titleImg.trim()) {
 altFinal = titleImg.trim();

 .join(' ');

 if (nomeFormatado.length > 3 && !nomeFormatado.match(/^\d+$/)) {
 altFinal = `${nomeFormatado} - CanalQb`;
 }
 }

 img.setAttribute("alt", altFinal);
 }

 console.log("&#10024; Widget Imagens: Todas as imagens já possuem ALT text!");
 }

 (function() {
 var $pager = $('#blog-pager');
 var $loadWrap = $('.load-more-posts');
 var $loadBtn = $('.load-more');
 var $spinner = $('.load-more > #load-icon');
 var $moreText = $('span.show-more-items');
 var olderPosts = $('a.blog-pager-older-link').attr('href');

 // Forçar 10 posts por vez
 function fixUrl(url) {
 if (!url) return url;
 if (url.indexOf('max-results=') > -1) {
 return url.replace(/max-results=\d+/, 'max-results=10');
 } else {
 return url + (url.indexOf('?') > -1 ? '&' : '?') + 'max-results=10';
 }
 }
 olderPosts = fixUrl(olderPosts);

 $pager.hide();
 $loadWrap.show();
 $loadBtn.show();

 var loading = false;

 function carregarMais() {
 if (loading || !olderPosts) return;
 loading = true;
 $spinner.show();
 $moreText.hide();

 $.ajax({
 url: olderPosts,
 success: function(res) {
 var $novos = $(res).find('.blog-posts');
 $novos.children('.status-msg-wrap').remove();
 $('.blog-posts').append($novos.html());

 var next = $(res).find('a.blog-pager-older-link').attr('href');
 olderPosts = fixUrl(next);

 // Remover duplicatas
 var vistos = {};
 $('.fbt-index-post').each(function() {
 var url = $(this).find('a').attr('href');
 if (vistos[url]) { $(this).remove(); }
 else { vistos[url] = true; }
 });

 if (olderPosts) {
 $moreText.text(typeof loadmore_txt !== 'undefined' ? loadmore_txt : 'Carregar mais postagens');
 } else {
 $loadBtn.hide();
 $loadWrap.hide();
 }
 },
 complete: function() {
 $spinner.hide();
 $moreText.show();
 loading = false;
 // Re-verificar se o botão ainda está visível para carregamento sequencial
 if (botaoVisivelNaTela()) { carregarMais(); }
 }
 });
 }

 // Clique manual
 $loadBtn.on('click', function(e) { e.preventDefault(); carregarMais(); });

 // Auto-load Sensível (IntersectionObserver com 600px de margem para antecipação)
 if ('IntersectionObserver' in window) {
 var observer = new IntersectionObserver(function(entries) {
 entries.forEach(function(entry) {
 if (entry.isIntersecting && olderPosts) { carregarMais(); }
 });
 }, { rootMargin: '600px' });
 if ($loadWrap.length) { observer.observe($loadWrap[0]); }
 }

 // Plano B: Auto-load Agressivo (Scroll + Idle)
 var idleTimer = null;
 function botaoVisivelNaTela() {
 if (!$loadWrap.length || !olderPosts || loading) return false;
 var rect = $loadWrap[0].getBoundingClientRect();
 // Aciona se o botão estiver a até 800px de entrar na tela (altíssima sensibilidade)
 return rect.top
